Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Thank you for calling Duroflex.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: May I speak to Satyam?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Satyam, Sleepyhead is under you, right?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes sir, Sleepyhead is Flex's sub-brand, but at the store level, you'll generally see Duroflex. Sleepyhead is mostly available online.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Tell me, do Duroflex or Sleepyhead have single seater recliners?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, Duroflex has them, Sleepyhead doesn't. Duroflex has them, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Is there a big difference between Duroflex and Sleepyhead?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: They are the same best quality. Duroflex is known for its foam and service quality. Manual recliners start at 18,000.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: And motorized?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Motorized has two options. One is Avalon motorized recliner, with a selling price of 31,500 with discount. And Avalon Posture Pro, a triple R recliner that rocks, rotates, and reclines, is 32,000 with discount for the fabric version, and 33,000 for the leather version.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: What was the price of just the recline one?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: 31,500. The actual cost is 46,000, but after discounts, it comes to 30,000 for the motorized recliner.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: That seems more expensive than Sleepyhead. I see recliners for 25,000, just reclining, no rotating.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: As a brand, we only have Duroflex products.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I got a call from them yesterday, saying the Viviana Mall store has Sleepyhead items.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir, Viviana Mall. We have a calling team, so you might have gotten a call from them.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: So you don't keep Sleepyhead items?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Not generally on the west side. But you can feel how the recliner works. You can feel that at the store.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I understand, for the experience.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: You can get the experience at the store. That's why they said that, because our store is an experience center.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: If I order from Sleepyhead's website and there's a delay, is your store answerable?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: No, sir. If you ordered online, the call you got is answerable. It's managed online, the store has nothing to do with it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: If you purchase from our store, you can ask us about delays.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I understand. So I can go to the store, but online has no physical contact.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: You can contact us anyway.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I can, but there's a difference between physically talking and online contact.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir, that's true.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, I understand. But if you are interested, you can come to the store.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, I want to come, but I'll see if I can come today. What was the price of the other one, the triple R?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: The triple R is our latest launch, it's 32,000 for the fabric version.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: If I explain it on the phone, it offers three-zone back support and pocket springs in the base, which distribute your weight equally. It also has zigzag springs for a smooth experience.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: The 32,000 one has reclining, rotating, and rocking?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, it has all of that.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Come and see. If you just want a recliner, I can tell you what Duroflex can offer. But there will be a cost difference because Duroflex is a sub-brand, and there's a costing difference.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, I'll come to the store and see. Thank you very much.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir, thank you for calling Duroflex. Have a nice day.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Thank you, you too. Bye.

Transcript_Log.Text: After discount?

Transcript_Log.Text: After discount, ₹33,000?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: ₹400. Okay. If we buy from there, what are the delivery charges?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Delivery is free to your home. If the stock is available, it will take 2-3 days, otherwise 12-14 days to deliver.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, if the stock is not available in our local warehouse. If it is a standard size and available, you will get it in 2-3 days.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Everything is included, delivery is totally included.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Delivery is included?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, free of cost delivery.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, if you kindly send me on WhatsApp, I can check and confirm.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: I will share the details of all the 8-inch mattresses with you. Please take a look.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Orthopedic, yes.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, orthopedic. I will share it shortly.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, thank you.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Thank you so much.

Transcript_Log.Text: Good evening, Duroflex.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Hello, good evening, sir. Actually, I need a king-size Black Magic mattress.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I want to inquire about it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir. Where are you calling from?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I am from Secunderabad, Venkatapuram.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, Venkatapuram.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Sir, please come to the store. You can experience the mattress.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I can do that, but if I see the prices and which one is better in Black Magic, then I will come personally with my family.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: In Black Magic, sir, there are two models: Black Magic and Black Magic Pro.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Black Magic and Black Magic Pro?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: It's not Black, sir, it's Back. Back Magic.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Back Magic?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, Back Magic and Back Magic Pro. Back Magic is a combination of coir and foam with layer technology. Back Magic Pro is a complete foam-based mattress. Rebonded foam and orthopedic.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Both are similar. The price depends on the size.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Size, like king size, 72 to 75.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: 72 to 75. 78 to 72 also comes, 72 to 72 also comes.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: 72 to 75 is ours.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Approximately, the price after discount will be around 23,000.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: What is the MRP? What is your name, sir?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: My name is Abrar.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Abrar ji, what is the MRP and how much discount are you giving?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: MRP is 29,000.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Which one? Black Magic Pro?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Black Magic, both have the same price.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Price is the same, but the facilities, the comfort, can you brief up a little, Abrar bhai?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir. Back Magic is an orthopedic support mattress with PU foam quilting. It has dual density, soft foam, hard foam, and five different zones.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Different layers?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Zones, not layers. Zones mean dividing the mattress into five parts. Head has less weight, shoulders have more weight, thighs have less weight, and legs have even less weight. So, it has five zones.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: The design is different. It puts pressure on different parts of the body, which improves blood circulation and relaxes muscles. It reduces back pain or prevents it in the future. Then comes coir, which keeps the mattress cool and maintains room temperature. Then comes rebonded foam, which is a hard material that prevents the mattress from sinking and provides hardness. So, you don't sink into the mattress and have trouble getting up. Then comes coir, HR foam, and coir, which provide flexibility and softness.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Back Magic Pro has an orthopedic support layer and a hard foam layer. It is a bit harder than Back Magic.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Which one do you suggest?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: What is the age of the users?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Young couple, around 38, with a small child.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Anyone can use it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: 38 is their age.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: 33 means anyone can use it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: 38, Abrar bhai, 38.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, 38.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Is their old mattress soft or hard?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: It was small, so we got a bigger one, 8 inches thick.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Is it soft?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: It is soft. Soft means soft. But you said it relieves back pain and prevents it in the future.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Back Magic, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Back Magic. Okay, okay. It protects from future pain.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: What is the variation in Pro?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: The amount is the same. The structure is different.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Structure variation? If there is back pain, it won't come or it will reduce, and it won't come in the future?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: It won't come in the future.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: What is in Pro?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Pro is the same. Only the 4-inch layer at the bottom is different. It has coir and rebonded foam. Pro only has rebonded foam.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay. What is the thickness of both?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: 6 inches.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: 6 inches thickness.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Some customers want it soft, some want it hard. So, there is a variation. That's why we have Back Magic and Back Magic Pro. Back Magic Pro is a bit harder.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay. Back Magic is a bit softer?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, softer.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Cushion, a bit cushion.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir.

Transcript_Log.Text: Send a quotation. If you give a good best price, I will inquire outside too. If you give the best price, I will contact you.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: You will get a better price than online.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Near Karkhana, there is a cement shop, right?

Transcript_Log.Text: Near the police station.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: No, the law and order police station.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, near the bus stand.

Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, near the grill line.

Transcript_Log.Text: Spine rest will come, 3 by 6.5 you said.

Transcript_Log.Text: It will cost 13,727. After discount it will be 11,943 rupees. Spine rest will come.

Transcript_Log.Text: Bonded foam, this is bonded foam and one roll pack is also there, I will tell you that also.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: That will cost you

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: 5 inch?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, 5 inch

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: 5 inch will cost you 12,199, after discount it will be 7,899.

Transcript_Log.Text: Local market can give in this rate?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Market will give, but if you want brand, best quality, then almost this price will be there. If you see other brands like Sleepwell, Livpure, then also almost this price will be there.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay

Transcript_Log.Text: Thank you, thank you for calling Duroflex.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Hello, thank you for calling Duroflex Gandhipuram showroom sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I called about the Utopia one, is it available?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: What size are you looking for, sir?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Utopia has a three-seater, right?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes sir, three-seater, yes sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: In that, the yellow or green color, yellow or green, is the stock immediately available for delivery tomorrow?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Immediately it won't be available, sir. We can place an order and get it for you in five days.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Amazon does it in two days, I thought you could do it faster, that's why I called. Amazon has Monday delivery.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: That's the delivery card, sir, but currently, the fabric for that color is low in stock at the factory. They might have put two days, maybe they had it in stock and can give it to you. But we will send a fresh piece manufactured from our factory.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: What do you have for immediate delivery?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Sofas are all short, sir. Immediate delivery is not available.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: How many days?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Five to six working days, sir. If you order today, we can get it to you by next Friday.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Is the East Plus model available?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, that is also available, sir. If you order that model, we can get it to you in five days maximum.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Five days?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes sir, five days.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Do you have East Plus on display?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: East Plus is not available, sir. We have many other sofa variants on display.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Is it cheaper? What's the difference between Utopia and East Plus?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Compared to Sophia, East Plus has a different foam thickness. It has 3-inch foam, while this has 4-inch foam. There are fabric differences and color options. That's why it's more budget-friendly.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Are there any offers going on?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Offers are available, sir, they vary from model to model. If you select a model, we can give you the best price.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Are there any credit card offers?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir. HDFC Bank credit card offers are available. If you purchase for 20,000 and opt for no-cost EMI, you get a discount of 1,000. Up to 60,000 purchase, you get 3,000 discount.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Do you deliver for Amazon or someone else?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: We are the seller, sir. If they had it in stock earlier, they can deliver it quickly in two days as you said.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Is there a difference if we buy from you? We have bought from you before.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I saw on Amazon, Duroflex has bad reviews. Why?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: What, sir? I didn't understand.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Service is bad, they are giving reviews like that. Your service is good.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Audible low, sir. Sorry sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Service is bad, they are giving reviews on Amazon. Delivery is different.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: They have given comments that the service is bad?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, on Amazon, there are star ratings.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: That's it, sir. Their delivery service might have had handling issues. That's why the product might have been damaged.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: You deliver, right? Delivery is by you?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: We don't deliver to Amazon. They are the buyer, they buy and sell.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Showroom is different?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Amazon handles the deliveries. Duroflex company doesn't do it. If you place an order with Duroflex, Duroflex will deliver it. Either through the official website or through showrooms like us. Furniture loading and mishandling can cause issues. That's why customers might have issues. Amazon and Flipkart have this drawback.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, I will come to the showroom.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Come to the showroom and see, sir. Decide after seeing. We have many variants. New launch three-seater recliner with sofa is launched. Come and see that.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: We already have a single-seater yellow and a blue puff.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir. Sophia MTO is a new variant launched. That variant is premium and good quality. Come and see that.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: MTO?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: MTO is a variant, sir. MTO.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I will check the website. I will come.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Come and see, sir. Okay, sir. Thank you, sir. Thank you for calling Duroflex.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Good afternoon sir, Duroflex Experience Center Anna Nagar.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Hello, sir, I bought a Duroflex mattress from the Ambattur showroom about one and a half years back.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, one second.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: In Duroflex.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Bolt Spring, Bolt Plus model name.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Bolt Plus 8 inches thickness. Yes, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I bought it one and a half years almost. It is not comfortable. It is sagging inside. I am planning to change it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I think they have only one or two pieces of selective models.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: They told me it is ortho, but it is sagging inside. Even though I am using a cover, it is still fresh. What should I do to change it?

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: First of all, sir, this mattress is not orthopedic supported. Bolt Spring mattress is interconnected springs. If you sit in a corner, the entire bed will be disturbed. Also, this mattress will not give full back support. It will be bouncy.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, it is bouncy and going inside.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: If you are not comfortable, you can change to a firmer or medium-firm mattress. For example, Duropedic categories, orthopedic support mattresses, coir foam mattresses, or rebonded foam mattresses. If you go without spring, it will be better for back support. You can complain where you bought it. Tell them you want to change it to a firmer or medium-firm mattress. Because there is a 10-year warranty period. If they don't support, you can contact customer care. The customer care number and mail ID are on the MRP label on the side of the mattress. Support@duroflexworld.com. There is a number 180010. You can call that number or mail them. Tell them you bought the mattress, but it doesn't have back support, it is bouncy and sagging. Attach the bill, mattress image, and side label image and mail it. They will check where you bought it and what to do. They will tell you the solution.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: If you want to directly exchange it, we will take your mattress for 2500.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Oh.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: We will take your old mattress for 2500 and when you buy a new one, we will minus that amount.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: That discount will be applied.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, so they have to support it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, sir. If you go through customer care, they will support you on a pro-data basis.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, I approached them first, but they told me to come after 4th or 5th. I think he is the dealer. They have multi-products, but they are doing Duroflex. Near the market.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: First, you push them.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: First, you push them. Two or three times push them. After that, if they say to contact customer care, then you can contact them. Don't tell them anything before that. First, see what they say. After that, you can go out. In case they take it and give you another mattress, there is a chance. They can directly finish it without going around. They have the rights because it is their shop. Try it once. If it is not working, then contact customer care.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Now, if I want to change the mattress, I have to give them an option because they have selective models.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: You can see the experience center. You have the nearest experience center. If you search, you will find it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: I called you from that number.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Yes, this is Anna Nagar. If you are saying Ambattur, we have opened a store in Perambur.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Perambur. Sometimes, when you see the location, Perambur will be near to Ambattur. Perambur means Senthil Nagar, Peravallur. Agram Junction will come there.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Near, recently opened.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: It is a big store. You can check there and tell them what you want. They will do it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: They will do it.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, okay. Thank you, sir.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Okay, sir. Thank you.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Customer
Transcript_Log.Text: Thank you for helping.

Transcript_Log.Speaker: Agent
Transcript_Log.Text: Thank you, sir.
